notes: This is Atlassian's shared 'Log in to continue' page, served from id.atlassian.com. It starts with an email field, a 'Remember me' checkbox and a blue Continue button. Below, a Passkey button and Google, Microsoft, Apple and Slack buttons are offered under 'Or continue with'. Isometric illustrations flank the card, with 'Can't log in?' and 'Create an account' links and a one-account footer. The page does not name the requesting app, and none of the Jira, Confluence or Compass scopes are shown.
